plan: A peaceful tree jungler who protects his allies and roots enemies with his vines.
aSurveiller: His Q (Rootcaller). It roots you and his allies can leap onto you: stay behind your minions.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his Q stops on the first one hit.
Kill Daisy (R) first if she hits your allies: she knocks them up.
He deals almost no damage: focus on his allies.
forces: Protects his allies well with his E.
His Q lets his allies leap in.

sorts.P: Clears jungle camps without fighting them.
sorts.Q: Vine that roots; allies can leap onto the target.

momentFort: Doesn't fight, but steals camps and helps his lanes from level 3 with his Q. Invade him: he can't defend himself alone.
